title: MyLittleCrafter Craft File
description: Schema for MyLittleCrafter crafting configuration files

Name.description: Display name for this craft configuration

Description.description: Human-readable description of what this craft does

ItemSelection.description: Query expression to select which items this craft applies to. Can be a simple string or complex object with Or/And/Count operators.

Conditions.description: List of crafting conditions to execute in order. Must contain at least one condition.

Type.description: The currency or craft type to use. If contains 'Craft' = Crafting Bench, if contains 'Reforge' = Harvest Bench, otherwise = Stackable Currency. Note: Cannot mix Crafting Bench and Harvest Bench in the same file.
examples: Craft +1 to Level of Socketed Gems

Query.description: Condition expression - can be a simple string or a complex object with Or/And/Count operators. Uses ItemFilterLibrary query syntax.

UseShift.description: Whether to hold Shift when using this currency/craft. Note: Only allowed for Stackable Currency (not bench/harvest crafts).

_comment.description: Optional comment for documentation purposes (ignored by parser)

QueryObject.description: Complex query object with logical operators (case-insensitive). Supports Or, And, and Count operators.

Or.description: Logical OR - any condition can match

or.description: Logical OR - any condition can match (lowercase variant)

And.description: Logical AND - all conditions must match

and.description: Logical AND - all conditions must match (lowercase variant)

oneOf.description: Count operator - counts how many conditions are true

QueryArray.description: Array of query expressions or nested query objects

oneOf.description: Query expression string using ItemFilterLibrary syntax
